states: vSphere VM table for a user with no saved preference at 1680px: header is Name, ID, CPU, Mem, Disk, Uptime, Tags, Net I/O, Disk I/O, so Tags is default-visible again on the scope that used to hide it

vSphere Tags cells now vary per row instead of repeating: warehouse-api-01 3 dots, warehouse-db-01 4, client-portal-01 2, finance-jump-01 3, ops-observability-01 2, edge-api-01 3, and 38 dots across the whole table
vSphere VMs that carry no vCenter tags render an empty Tags cell rather than falling back to the provenance keyword set: etl-batch-01 and ingress-proxy-02 show 0 dots
vSphere host group-header rows carry no tag dots, so host tags do not leak into the VM rows grouped beneath them

vSphere VM table for a user whose saved preference predates this change (seeded workloadsHiddenColumns:vmware-vms of aiContext/os/ip): the one-time migration adds only backup, the applied marker records aiContext/backup, and Tags stays visible
vSphere column picker reports 4 hidden and offers Tags checked, Backup unchecked, AI Context unchecked, OS unchecked, IP unchecked, Disk/Uptime/Net I/O/Disk I/O checked

vSphere at 390px: the phone stage renders Name, CPU, Mem across 25 rows with Tags dropped by the responsive stage as the wide-only contract requires, and no horizontal body overflow (table scrollWidth within container clientWidth for both tables)
Proxmox workload table unaffected at 1680px: Tags and Backup both still visible with genuine per-guest counts varying 3 to 7 dots per row, and the stored hidden list unchanged at aiContext/os/ip
Tag tooltip on a vSphere dot reads the real vCenter label Backup:Nightly rather than a provenance string

Filtered state after clicking that dot: search reads tags:Backup:Nightly and the table narrows from 18 VMs to the 3 that carry the tag (warehouse-api-01, warehouse-db-01, mariadb-replica-01) plus their host group headers
